newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle prices up $1-$2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle prices up $1-$2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were $1.00 to $2.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 73.00-80.00, few blacks 86.00-86.50; 700- 800 lbs 74.50-77.75, and 13 head 714 lbs 81.00; 800-900 lbs 65.50-68.25. Medium and Large 2 700-800 lbs few 71.00. Holstein Large 2 600-700 lbs 64.00-65.00.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 65.75-66.00; 17 head blacks 724 lbs 72.10. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 71.50-74.00.
